request: CIの性能・VerifyケースにMaxと構造的難ケースが含まれるか点検し不足を補う。

local.method: Read-only static audit. No compilation, execution, generation of large inputs, network, or repository edits.

facts.finding: ci_verify --all selects every entry, then prepare_verify.run_tests compiles checked+skip and executes entry.samples only. No stress generator hook.
All selected entries are instrumented, but execution still loops entry.samples. LC official large cases are not sanitizer/coverage inputs.

Small stdin often triggers fixed-seed internal differential tests; these count as real CI cases. However sizes are bounded low: graph negative randomN<=14, DijkstraN<=600; LCA N<=40; dynamic hash hash3000ops and treap1500ops. Numeric/key-universe extremes are present.
facts.evidence: registered groups point to these exact drivers

facts.finding: These are discovered by maintenance unittest, and do execute C++ regression tests. Graph custom-inf covers thresholds N64/65/256/257/4096/4097, negative cycles and near-int64 infinities; line2d22 cases include ±2e18 results and 20×80-operation boundary-random traces. They are not online maximum N/Q cases.
facts.evidence: unittest discovery in verify.yml plus SOURCE declarations/check_compiler

facts.finding: Fenwick/segment/lazy vectors length7; UF6; LowLink5; RollingHash bytes7. Good exceptions/postfailure checks, no scale maximum claim.
No runner/group/Python-test reference to these files was found. In particular groups test includes N1048577 and sparse INT_MAX, but those are not current CI executions.
facts.evidence: static exact-name rg over Scripts/.github/Verify/current/groups returned no matches

facts.finding: Only official3 samples: N5,Q10; N10,Q12; N4,Q11. Earlier /tmp maximum profiles are not committed inputs nor runner references, so cannot count as CI.

structured queue/relaxation killers beyond current N4097 chain tests

recommendation.architecture: Separate deterministic ci_stress job with a committed catalog and on-demand generators, not huge inline JSON samples.
recommendation.execution: Generate one case at a time outside repository; run actual submitted driver and validate full output, report case hash/dimensions/source hash/elapsed/RSS and whether exact maximum or representative stress. Limit max runs to one compiler/default path; reduced twins across checked/fallback/sanitizer avoid full-max multiplication.
recommendation.validation: Pure generation/schema small tests now; compiler and full stress runs on GitHub rather than heavy local host.
recommendation.honest_coverage: Explicitly list untouched/non-LC entries without max coverage; all-entry Verify means all registered samples, not all maxima/killer inputs.

official.scope: Read-only static audit. No compile, test run, generation, fetch, or repository mutation.
official.current_ci_selection: changed targets only: workflow passes --base, not --all

runner_guarantees.description: info.toml lists all test groups, names/counts expanded without max/killer filtering
hash.json keys must exactly equal every expected .in and .out; directory names and SHA checked
official checker executable required; no string comparison for arbitrary valid witnesses
PASS requires all nonempty expected cases completed, first failure stops with explicit partial counts

confirmed_generator_examples.proof: fixed-commit info=params plus both generator bodies assign MAX_N/MAX_Q. conchon is explicitly paired with expected-TLE solution in info.toml.
Both source generators assign n=q=N_AND_Q_MAX; hand_max constructs many changing minima.
Both sources assign N_AND_Q_MAX; all_intersect constructs intersecting interval tree shapes and broad insertion.
Generator assigns n=uniform(1,N_MAX), q=Q_MAX. Example of why naming alone does not prove every parameter reaches max.

gaps.finding: A normal future PR runs official full cases only for changed drivers/dependencies, whereas sample/local Verify is --all.
gaps.recommendation: If intent is every registered LC Max/killer on every PR, pass --all explicitly (144 drivers/90 problems), and keep report selection scope explicit.

gaps.finding: Per-case timeout defaults to30s; official timelimit is metadata only. This is not a proof of judge-limit speed and current 3-API benchmark cannot flag all library performance regressions.
gaps.recommendation: Separate correctness budget from speed claims, expose per-case maximum and official limit, expand meaningful deterministic kernel shapes elsewhere; do not impose official online times as identical GH hardware timings.

gaps.finding: Names max/killer are not sufficient proof of independent dimensions or library-specific adversarial coverage; all90 info files are present, but only selected generator bodies were inspected.
gaps.recommendation: Maintain explicit stress-case families with fixed parameters/oracles and report claims at the case-family scope.

gaps.finding: Direct unit regressions cover input hash/missing input, empty/duplicate cases, full completion, checker result/nonunique witness, timeouts, and shard coverage. Missing output/checker/extra case/hash manifest mismatch have the same runtime guard but lack separate focused tests.
gaps.recommendation: Add inexpensive mocked missing.out, missing checker, extra/missing hash key, and omitted-last-case tests; no C++ compile needed.
